payload.title: Push adapters: APNs + FCM, per-tenant credentials, delivery telemetry
payload.description: Port the push delivery pipeline per docs/push-adapters.md: APNs (JWT-based, HTTP/2) and FCM adapters, per-tenant credential storage + CLI management, delivery telemetry readback, and the typed FrickPushPayload contract consumed by the client SDKs (docs/push-receive.md — payload shape must not change).
